_comment: Position calibration preset for the sim2 drone (Sphinx simulator, drone-6) derived from flight_2026-05-05_21-54-03_drone-6_sim2.jsonl. Matches the schema of position_presets.json — paste any single entry below into the web UI's 'Import Preset' box, or copy into position_presets.json under the 'sim2' key, restart the controller, and apply via /proxy/position/presets/apply.

_source.git_revision: d1dcf99 (ams: enlarge PerimeterPath ellipse so vehicles don't pile up)
_source.rationale: Position estimate drifted to x=-13 m which is OUTSIDE the arena bbox (x ∈ [-10, +10]). Single-tick jumps up to 9.9 m indicate the unfiltered estimator was accepting bad pose computations. The preset below tightens outlier rejection, raises Kalman process variance to absorb sim-specific motion, and increases the IMU weight to 0.5 since the simulated IMU is noise-free. distance_scale held at 1.0 — Sphinx's pinhole camera has no scale bias. fov_deg=69 matches the Anafi/sim camera. marker_size_m=0.495 matches the YAML emitter (walls scaled to 0.495).

sim2_strict._label: sim2 strict (rejects bigger jumps, slower response)

sim2_responsive._label: sim2 responsive (looser jump filter, faster blend)
